urtica_dioica.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for a lighter yellow-green; iron minimally.
pH: neutral to slightly acidic.
Temperature: moderate hot extraction.
Important: the green does not simply come from chlorophyll; chlorophyll tones from a water bath are unstable.
urtica_dioica.Багрилна съставка: What takes part in the dye bath is mainly flavonoids and other water-soluble phenolic compounds. Chlorophyll is poorly soluble in water and unstable when heated, so the final textile colour is usually yellow-green rather than a bright green.
urtica_dioica.Как се държи: The aerial parts give yellow-greens through grey-greens, but do not expect a bright leaf green. The colour is muted and the fastness moderate.
urtica_dioica.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: during the growing season, on a dry day; choose sound, fully grown leaves and tops. For flowering herbs, from the beginning of bloom to full bloom is the most practical window.
What is gathered: leaves · stems · the aerial parts.
Processing: use fresh or dry in the shade, in a thin layer with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.

persicaria_tinctoria.Багрилни качества:
Process: a particular indigo process; choose one method and follow its own pH and temperature requirements.
Mordant: not needed.
pH: alkaline in a reduction vat; fresh-leaf dyeing works under different conditions.
Temperature: no single range applies; it depends on the method.
Gathering: use fresh leaves and young tops, and work them quickly.
persicaria_tinctoria.Багрилна съставка: The leaves contain indoxyl precursors, chiefly indican and related compounds. As these break down, indoxyl forms and oxidises into insoluble indigo; a reduction vat makes it temporarily soluble so that it can enter the fibre.
persicaria_tinctoria.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: in summer, before or just as flowering starts; several cuts are possible if nodes are left for regrowth.
What is gathered: the leaves and young tops.
Processing: for fresh-leaf dyeing, use at once. For pigment or sukumo the material goes through a separate fermentation process; this is not an ordinary hot decoction.
Storage: for the fresh method, do not store; for dried or fermented material, follow the indigo process chosen.
persicaria_tinctoria.Как се държи: Fresh leaves hold indigo precursors and are used by particular methods — fresh-leaf dyeing, extraction, or a reduction or fermentation vat. Depth of blue is built by repeated dips and oxidation in air; this is not an ordinary dye bath.

tanacetum_vulgare.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for a clean yellow; iron for olive.
pH: neutral to slightly acidic keeps the yellow.
Temperature: moderate hot extraction.
Eco print: the flower heads leave marks and texture; the leaves suit a ground better than a very sharp silhouette.
tanacetum_vulgare.Багрилна съставка: The yellow comes mainly from flavonoids and related phenolic compounds. They bind to the fibre better through a mordant, and change hue as they complex with iron.
tanacetum_vulgare.Как се държи: The flower heads are the stronger dye part and give a clear yellow through to yellow-green. Among local yellow plants, tansy gives a comparatively strong and recognisable result.
tanacetum_vulgare.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: on a dry day, when the flowers or flower heads are fully out; for the most even material, choose sound, unwilted plants.
What is gathered: flower heads · leaves.
Processing: use fresh, or spread in a thin layer and dry in the shade with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.

anthemis_tinctoria.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for a clean yellow; iron only in small amounts, for olive tones.
pH: neutral to slightly acidic keeps the yellow cleaner.
Temperature: moderate hot extraction; avoid a long boil.
Eco print: the flowers can leave yellow marks, but the leaf silhouette is softer than that of strongly tannic plants.
anthemis_tinctoria.Багрилна съставка: The main colourants are flavonoids, including luteolin and apigenin derivatives. They form complexes with metal mordants, which accounts for the clear yellow with alum and the shift towards darker olives with iron.
anthemis_tinctoria.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: on a dry day, when the flowers or flower heads are fully out; for the most even material, choose sound, unwilted plants.
What is gathered: flowers · leaves.
Processing: use fresh, or spread in a thin layer and dry in the shade with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.
anthemis_tinctoria.Как се държи: The flowers and leaves give clean yellows through ochres; with iron they shift to olive and grey-green. An alum mordant suits it best where a clear yellow is the aim. The colour is fairly predictable, though the depth depends on how much fresh or dried material goes in.

rhamnus_tinctoria.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for a clear yellow; iron for olive.
pH: strongly affects the yellow range.
Temperature: moderate hot extraction.
Important: the botanical identity of commercial „Persian berries“ matters for repeatability.
rhamnus_tinctoria.Багрилна съставка: The yellow range comes mainly from flavonoid colourants, including rhamnetin and quercetin-type derivatives in the dyer's Rhamnus species. These flavonoids form complexes with mordants and change hue with pH.
rhamnus_tinctoria.Как се държи: The berries give a strong yellow, mustard and warm ochre. The colour is sensitive to pH and to metal mordants; iron shifts it towards olive. Use ripe dye material and run small tests, because different Rhamnus species and commercial materials can differ.
rhamnus_tinctoria.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: when the fruit or rind in question is ripe, or as fresh kitchen or garden waste.
What is used: fruit.
Processing: clean off any remains, cut or crush as needed; can be used fresh, frozen or dried depending on the material.
Storage: dried material keeps somewhere dark and dry; fresh material — use soon or freeze.

paubrasilia_echinata.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: an alum mordant supports the clear reds; use iron sparingly.
pH: a strongly pH-sensitive dye.
Temperature: hot extraction suits it, but a long boil is not needed.
Fastness: the colours are beautiful, but the lightfastness can be weaker than madder's.
paubrasilia_echinata.Багрилна съставка: The main colourant is brazilin, which oxidises into the more strongly coloured brazilein. The wood also contains tannins and phenolics; how these interact with pH and metal ions accounts for the wide range from red to purple-brown.
paubrasilia_echinata.Как се държи: The heartwood gives bright pink-reds through to burgundy. The hue varies a great deal with the conditions and the handling — from a warm red to more purple casts.
paubrasilia_echinata.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: the material is usually bought as ready shavings, chips or powder; if gathering your own, use only legally obtained or waste wood.
What is used: heartwood.
Processing: cut or crush into small pieces for better extraction; dry material can be soaked beforehand.
Storage: fully dry, somewhere dark and airy.

senegalia_catechu.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: will dye without a metal mordant; alum lightens and clears, iron darkens.
pH: neutral to slightly alkaline can deepen the brown.
Temperature: a hot bath suits it.
Cellulose: the material brings its own tannin and often needs no separate tannin pre-bath.
senegalia_catechu.Багрилна съставка: Cutch is rich in catechins and condensed tannins. These polyphenols have an affinity of their own for the fibre and readily form dark complexes with iron, which accounts for the good substantivity and the durable browns.
senegalia_catechu.Как се държи: Cutch is a strongly substantive brown dye: cinnamon, terracotta, reddish brown and chocolate. The colour builds well with repeated baths and reacts strongly with iron, which takes it much darker. Its high tannin content also suits it to cellulose.
senegalia_catechu.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: the material is usually bought as ready shavings, chips or powder; if gathering your own, use only legally obtained or waste wood.
What is used: heartwood.
Processing: cut or crush into small pieces for better extraction; dry material can be soaked beforehand.
Storage: fully dry, somewhere dark and airy.
